linearGenerator.role: continuous seed completing the sp4 Lie closure

antiunitaryEdge.symbol: Gamma=G K with K complex conjugation
antiunitaryEdge.role: uniform sheet flip and coherent central-minus lift

noGo.statement: No ordinary complex-linear Hamiltonian time evolution U can equal Gamma on a nonzero complex source space.
noGo.proof: U(i z)=i U(z), whereas Gamma(i z)=-i Gamma(z).
noGo.consequence: the connected Wilson-source cover cannot be generated by merely tuning the coefficient of the existing complex-linear pulse

realification.meaning: a continuous real orthogonal quarter-turn exists only after forgetting or doubling the original complex structure

physicalRoutes: Nambu/Majorana or particle-hole doubling with a CAR and charge audit
a defect, boundary or interface sewing rather than time evolution
a symmetry relating conjugate histories rather than a dynamical pulse
an open-system operation whose enlarged dilation is complex-linear
verdict: The continuous Spin(2,3) seed and the sheet-flipping edge operation are related by a shared G but require different physical typings. The latter needs real/Nambu doubling, a boundary sewing, or an enlarged open-system realization.
